```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ================================================================
## SCAMP ROI-like spatial pattern analysis
## ---------------------------------------------------------------
## Input expected in the working directory:
##   MB_PPi_data_combined.csv
##
## Expected structure:
##   column 1: fish/sample identifier
##   column 2: treatment code
##   column 3: replicate/other metadata
##   column 4: genotype code
##   remaining columns: longitudinal SCAMP fluorescence profile
##
## This complementary analysis uses treatment-specific thresholds
## solely to compare spatial patterns of continuous positive regions.
## It is not an analysis of absolute fluorescence or absolute positive area.
## ================================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "patchwork",
  "knitr",
  "lmerTest",
  "emmeans"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required package(s): ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them before running this notebook."
  )
}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

## Sum-to-zero contrasts are used for interpretable Type III tests.
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

## -----------------------------
## User-editable settings
## -----------------------------

analysis_root <- normalizePath(
  getwd(),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

scamp_data_path <- file.path(analysis_root, "MB_PPi_data_combined.csv")

output_dir <- file.path(
  analysis_root,
  "Results",
  "ROI_like_spatial_analysis_S6_only"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Figures")
statistics_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Statistics")
qc_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "QC")

ensure_output_dirs <- function() {
  output_directories <- c(
    output_dir,
    figure_dir,
    statistics_dir,
    qc_dir
  )

  for (current_directory in output_directories) {
    if (!dir.exists(current_directory)) {
      dir.create(
        current_directory,
        recursive = TRUE,
        showWarnings = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  missing_directories <- output_directories[
    !vapply(output_directories, dir.exists, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(missing_directories) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not create output directorie(s): ",
      paste(missing_directories, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  invisible(output_directories)
}

ensure_output_dirs()

target_length <- 1000L
fixed_columns <- 4L
background_quantile <- 0.60
mad_multiplier <- 3
loess_span <- 0.75

## -----------------------------
## Experimental labels and colours
## -----------------------------

genotype_labels <- c(
  "2_het" = "abcc6a+/-",
  "3_mut" = "abcc6a-/-"
)

treatment_levels <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB",
  "_-PPi_+MB",
  "_+PPi_-MB",
  "_+PPi_+MB"
)

treatment_labels <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB" = "-MB\n-PPi",
  "_-PPi_+MB" = "+MB\n-PPi",
  "_+PPi_-MB" = "-MB\n+PPi",
  "_+PPi_+MB" = "+MB\n+PPi"
)

mb_map <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB" = "-MB",
  "_-PPi_+MB" = "+MB",
  "_+PPi_-MB" = "-MB",
  "_+PPi_+MB" = "+MB"
)

ppi_map <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB" = "-PPi",
  "_-PPi_+MB" = "-PPi",
  "_+PPi_-MB" = "+PPi",
  "_+PPi_+MB" = "+PPi"
)

ppi_cols <- c(
  "-PPi" = "#FFFFFF",
  "+PPi" = "#000000"
)

genotype_background_data <- tibble(
  genotype = factor(
    unname(genotype_labels),
    levels = unname(genotype_labels)
  )
)

scamp_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

# 1. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
## -----------------------------
## Profile length normalization
## -----------------------------

normalize_row <- function(row, target_length = 1000L) {
  row <- as.numeric(row)
  valid <- which(is.finite(row))

  if (length(valid) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, target_length))
  }

  row <- row[min(valid):max(valid)]

  if (length(row) == 1) {
    return(rep(row, target_length))
  }

  approx(
    x = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(row)),
    y = row,
    xout = seq(0, 1, length.out = target_length),
    rule = 2
  )$y
}

## -----------------------------
## Treatment-specific threshold
## -----------------------------

estimate_positive_threshold <- function(pixel_matrix,
                                        background_quantile = 0.60,
                                        multiplier = 3) {
  values <- as.numeric(pixel_matrix)
  values <- values[is.finite(values) & values >= 0]

  cutoff <- unname(quantile(
    values,
    probs = background_quantile,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE,
    type = 7
  ))

  background_values <- values[values <= cutoff]
  baseline <- median(background_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  noise_mad <- mad(
    background_values,
    center = baseline,
    constant = 1.4826,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    threshold = baseline + multiplier * noise_mad,
    baseline = baseline,
    noise_mad = noise_mad,
    lower_tail_cutoff = cutoff,
    background_quantile = background_quantile,
    multiplier = multiplier,
    method = "low-tail median + multiplier × scaled MAD"
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## Continuous positive regions
## -----------------------------

extract_positive_regions <- function(binary_profile) {
  binary_profile[is.na(binary_profile)] <- FALSE
  runs <- rle(binary_profile)
  run_ends <- cumsum(runs$lengths)
  run_starts <- run_ends - runs$lengths + 1L
  positive_runs <- which(runs$values)

  if (length(positive_runs) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  tibble(
    region_id = seq_along(positive_runs),
    start_index = run_starts[positive_runs],
    end_index = run_ends[positive_runs],
    region_length = runs$lengths[positive_runs],
    centroid_index = (run_starts[positive_runs] + run_ends[positive_runs]) / 2,
    AP_position_percent =
      ((centroid_index - 1) / (length(binary_profile) - 1)) * 100,
    relative_region_length_percent =
      (region_length / length(binary_profile)) * 100
  )
}

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), NA_character_, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 3))
}

format_p_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "n.c.",
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}
```

# 2. Load and normalize SCAMP fluorescence profiles

```{r load-and-normalize-data}
if (!file.exists(scamp_data_path)) {
  stop("SCAMP input file not found: ", scamp_data_path)
}

scamp_raw <- read.csv2(
  scamp_data_path,
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (ncol(scamp_raw) <= fixed_columns) {
  stop("No fluorescence-profile columns found after the first four metadata columns.")
}

pixel_data <- t(apply(
  scamp_raw[, (fixed_columns + 1):ncol(scamp_raw), drop = FALSE],
  1,
  normalize_row,
  target_length = target_length
))

storage.mode(pixel_data) <- "numeric"
colnames(pixel_data) <- paste0("P", seq_len(target_length))

meta <- tibble(
  fish = make.unique(as.character(scamp_raw[[1]])),
  treatment_raw = as.character(scamp_raw[[2]]),
  genotype_raw = as.character(scamp_raw[[4]])
) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = factor(
      genotype_raw,
      levels = names(genotype_labels),
      labels = genotype_labels
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      unname(treatment_labels[treatment_raw]),
      levels = unname(treatment_labels)
    ),
    MB = factor(
      unname(mb_map[treatment_raw]),
      levels = c("-MB", "+MB")
    ),
    PPi = factor(
      unname(ppi_map[treatment_raw]),
      levels = c("-PPi", "+PPi")
    )
  )

keep <- complete.cases(meta[, c("genotype", "treatment", "MB", "PPi")])
meta <- meta[keep, ]
pixel_data <- pixel_data[keep, , drop = FALSE]

if (!all(c("fish", "genotype", "treatment", "MB", "PPi") %in% names(meta))) {
  stop("Required metadata columns could not be constructed.")
}

kable(
  meta %>% count(genotype, MB, PPi),
  caption = "Specimen numbers by genotype and treatment"
)
```

# 3. Treatment-specific thresholding

```{r treatment-specific-thresholds}
ensure_output_dirs()

## Genotypes are pooled within each MB/PPi treatment when estimating the
## pattern-detection threshold. These thresholds are used only for the
## complementary relative-pattern analysis.

threshold_table <- map_dfr(levels(meta$treatment), function(current_treatment) {
  specimen_index <- which(meta$treatment == current_treatment)

  estimate_positive_threshold(
    pixel_data[specimen_index, , drop = FALSE],
    background_quantile = background_quantile,
    multiplier = mad_multiplier
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = current_treatment,
      n_fish = length(specimen_index),
      .before = 1
    )
})

write.csv2(
  threshold_table,
  file.path(qc_dir, "ROI_like_treatment_specific_thresholds.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kable(
  threshold_table,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Treatment-specific thresholds used for spatial pattern detection"
)
```

# 4. Extract continuous positive regions

```{r extract-positive-regions}
ensure_output_dirs()

binary_profiles <- matrix(
  FALSE,
  nrow = nrow(pixel_data),
  ncol = ncol(pixel_data),
  dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("P", seq_len(ncol(pixel_data))))
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta))) {
  current_threshold <- threshold_table$threshold[
    match(as.character(meta$treatment[i]), threshold_table$treatment)
  ]

  binary_profiles[i, ] <- pixel_data[i, ] > current_threshold
}

regions <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(meta)), function(i) {
  extract_positive_regions(binary_profiles[i, ]) %>%
    mutate(
      fish = meta$fish[i],
      genotype = meta$genotype[i],
      treatment = meta$treatment[i],
      MB = meta$MB[i],
      PPi = meta$PPi[i],
      .before = 1
    )
})

if (nrow(regions) == 0) {
  stop("No continuous threshold-positive regions were detected.")
}

write.csv2(
  regions,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_positive_regions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kable(
  regions %>%
    group_by(genotype, MB, PPi) %>%
    summarise(
      fish = n_distinct(fish),
      regions = n(),
      mean_relative_length = mean(relative_region_length_percent),
      median_relative_length = median(relative_region_length_percent),
      .groups = "drop"
    ),
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Descriptive summary of continuous positive regions"
)
```

# 5. Region-length linear mixed-effects model

```{r region-length-mixed-model}
ensure_output_dirs()

## Multiple continuous regions can originate from the same fish. Region length
## is therefore analysed with fish identity included as a random intercept.

AP_mean <- mean(regions$AP_position_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
AP_sd <- sd(regions$AP_position_percent, na.rm = TRUE)

regions <- regions %>%
  mutate(AP_position_scaled = (AP_position_percent - AP_mean) / AP_sd)

region_length_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
  relative_region_length_percent ~
    genotype * MB * PPi * AP_position_scaled +
    (1 | fish),
  data = regions,
  REML = FALSE
)

region_length_type3 <- anova(
  region_length_model,
  type = 3,
  ddf = "Satterthwaite"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = `Pr(>F)`,
    p_value_formatted = format_p_value(p_value),
    significance = format_p_stars(p_value)
  )

## AP-axis slopes for every genotype × MB × PPi group.
region_slopes <- emmeans::emtrends(
  region_length_model,
  specs = ~ genotype * MB * PPi,
  var = "AP_position_scaled"
)

region_slopes_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(region_slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
)

## PPi contrasts of AP-axis slopes within each genotype and MB condition.
ppi_slope_contrasts <- contrast(
  region_slopes,
  method = "revpairwise",
  by = c("genotype", "MB"),
  adjust = "none"
)

ppi_slope_contrasts_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(ppi_slope_contrasts, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value_raw = p.value,
    p_value_BH = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    significant_BH = p_value_BH < 0.05
  )

write.csv2(
  region_length_type3,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_region_length_TypeIII_mixed_model.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv2(
  region_slopes_table,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_AP_axis_slopes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv2(
  ppi_slope_contrasts_table,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_PPi_slope_contrasts_BH.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  region_length_model,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_region_length_mixed_model.rds")
)

kable(
  region_length_type3,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Type III tests from the region-length linear mixed-effects model"
)

kable(
  region_slopes_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Estimated AP-axis slopes by genotype, MB and PPi"
)

kable(
  ppi_slope_contrasts_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "PPi contrasts of AP-axis slopes within genotype and MB condition;",
    "BH correction applied jointly across the four contrasts"
  )
)
```

# 6. ROI-like visualizations

```{r roi-like-visualizations, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
ensure_output_dirs()

## -----------------------------
## Descriptive LOESS visualization
## -----------------------------

p_region_loess <- ggplot(
  regions,
  aes(
    x = AP_position_percent,
    y = relative_region_length_percent,
    colour = PPi,
    fill = PPi
  )
) +
  geom_rect(
    data = genotype_background_data %>%
      filter(genotype == unname(genotype_labels["2_het"])),
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#261A68",
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = genotype_background_data %>%
      filter(genotype == unname(genotype_labels["3_mut"])),
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#B61515",
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 1.5,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    span = loess_span,
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.16
  ) +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ MB) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ppi_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ppi_cols) +
  scamp_theme +
  labs(
    x = "Relative anterior-posterior position (%)",
    y = "Relative positive-region length (% of normalized profile)",
    title = "Descriptive distribution of continuous positive regions"
  )

## -----------------------------
## Linear mixed-model predictions
## -----------------------------

prediction_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  genotype = levels(regions$genotype),
  MB = levels(regions$MB),
  PPi = levels(regions$PPi),
  AP_position_percent = seq(0, 100, length.out = 200)
) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = levels(regions$genotype)),
    MB = factor(MB, levels = levels(regions$MB)),
    PPi = factor(PPi, levels = levels(regions$PPi)),
    AP_position_scaled = (AP_position_percent - AP_mean) / AP_sd
  )

fixed_formula <- lme4::nobars(formula(region_length_model))
X_prediction <- model.matrix(
  delete.response(terms(fixed_formula)),
  prediction_grid
)

fixed_coefficients <- lme4::fixef(region_length_model)
fixed_vcov <- as.matrix(vcov(region_length_model))

prediction_grid$fit <- as.numeric(X_prediction %*% fixed_coefficients)
prediction_grid$SE <- sqrt(pmax(
  0,
  rowSums((X_prediction %*% fixed_vcov) * X_prediction)
))

prediction_grid <- prediction_grid %>%
  mutate(
    lower = fit - 1.96 * SE,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * SE
  )

write.csv2(
  prediction_grid,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_linear_mixed_model_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_region_linear <- ggplot(
  regions,
  aes(
    x = AP_position_percent,
    y = relative_region_length_percent,
    colour = PPi,
    fill = PPi
  )
) +
  geom_rect(
    data = genotype_background_data %>%
      filter(genotype == unname(genotype_labels["2_het"])),
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#261A68",
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = genotype_background_data %>%
      filter(genotype == unname(genotype_labels["3_mut"])),
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#B61515",
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.4,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0)
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = prediction_grid,
    aes(
      x = AP_position_percent,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      fill = PPi,
      group = PPi
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.16,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = prediction_grid,
    aes(
      x = AP_position_percent,
      y = fit,
      colour = PPi,
      group = PPi
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.85
  ) +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ MB) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ppi_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ppi_cols) +
  scamp_theme +
  labs(
    x = "Relative anterior-posterior position (%)",
    y = "Relative positive-region length (% of normalized profile)",
    title = "Linear mixed-effects model predictions"
  )

p_region_loess
p_region_linear
```
